name: 下巴-下颌细节分析
algorithm: Chin-Jaw Detail — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes chin and jawline detail for deepfake detection:

1. **Jawline轮廓提取**: Facial landmarks along the mandible and chin are tracked per frame to extract the jawline contour. The contour is parameterized using curvature measures, capturing the anatomical shape signature unique to each individual.

2. **Sub-Mandibular区域分析**: The region beneath the chin and along the jawline is examined for anatomical detail — skin folds, adipose tissue distribution, and the chin-neck junction. These areas are challenging for deepfake generators because they occur at the boundary of the face-swap region and often exhibit generation artifacts.

3. **时间轮廓稳定性**: The jawline contour is tracked across frames during speech and head movement. Natural jawlines deform smoothly according to musculoskeletal constraints — the mandible rotates on the temporomandibular joint with predictable kinematics. Deepfake-generated jawlines may exhibit unnatural deformations, warping, or contour instability.

4. **下巴-Neck边界相干性**: The boundary between the face-generated region and the original neck/body is a critical artifact location for face-swap deepfakes. The method analyzes texture, color, and geometric continuity at this boundary — discontinuities indicate where the generated face mesh fails to blend seamlessly with the original body.

5. **Detail分辨率评估**: Fine details along the jawline (stubble, skin texture, moles) are analyzed for rendering quality and temporal consistency. Deepfake generators often produce lower-resolution detail in peripheral face regions (chin, jaw) compared to central regions (eyes, nose), creating a detectable detail gradient.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through chin-jaw detail analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
